question: What alternative proportional measure is authorized according to earlier prescription?
premises: An alternative proportional measure is allowed.
The measure may be half the rise.
This follows what is recited at the beginning.
inference: Alternatively, the measure may be half the rise, as prescribed in the earlier enumeration.
uncertainties: The reading yādādau is slightly unclear; taken as referring to what is stated at the beginning.
plain_english: Or it may be half the measure of the rise, as is prescribed at the beginning.
